correctness.rationale: For n>=3, each time-two pair of 3-bit columns encodes 64 symbols. Period-two constraints for both phases depend only on triples, so all n-step closed walks in the 4096-vertex two-time de Bruijn graph biject with F_n^2 fixed configurations. Independently assembled all 262144 possible triples, 6140 valid edges and Kosaraju SCCs (4038 total); only cyclic components are (30 vertices,75 internal edges), (27,81) and (4,4). First two are time-diagonal, last has exactly the four directed edges on nodes 455,504,3640,3591. Therefore only four nonfixed returns when 4|n, giving two temporal 2-orbits. Direct original-rule full configurations n=3..6 corroborate. Finite exhaustive graph establishes all ring lengths, unlike mere bounded brute force.
